SELECT COALESCE(ar.ingredient_id,hr.ingredient_id) ingredient_id, COALESCE(i.ingredient_name_std,i.ingredient_name_raw,hai.ingredient_name_std,hai.ingredient_name_raw,hi.ingredient_name_std,hi.ingredient_name_raw,ar.ingredient_name_raw,hr.ingredient_name_raw) ingredient_name, COALESCE(i.base_unit,hai.base_unit,hi.base_unit) master_unit,COALESCE(ar.base_unit,hr.base_unit) base_unit, CASE WHEN COALESCE(ar.review_flag,hr.review_flag)=0 THEN COALESCE(ar.qty_per_person,hr.qty_per_person)*d.planned_servings END quantity, COALESCE(m.menu_name,hm.menu_name) menu_name,d.menu_id,d.meal_date FROM (
SELECT #{meal.menu_id} menu_id,#{meal.planned_servings} planned_servings, COALESCE(#{meal.meal_date},#{date_from}) meal_date
) d LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_menu_master m ON m.account_id=#{account_id} AND m.menu_id=d.menu_id AND m.del_yn='N' LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_recipe_detail ar ON ar.account_id=m.account_id AND ar.menu_id=m.menu_id LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_master i ON i.account_id=ar.account_id AND i.ingredient_id=ar.ingredient_id LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_menu_master hm ON m.menu_id IS NULL AND hm.menu_id=d.menu_id AND hm.del_yn='N' LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_recipe_detail hr ON hr.menu_id=hm.menu_id LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_ingredient_master hi ON hi.ingredient_id=hr.ingredient_id
LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_master hai ON hai.account_id=#{account_id} AND hai.ingredient_id=hr.ingredient_id

SELECT ,r.total_required_qty quantity,r.base_unit,ms.meal_date FROM the_full_order.tb_account_meal_ingredient_requirement r JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_meal_service ms ON ms.meal_service_id=r.meal_service_id JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_table_meals t ON t.table_id=ms.table_id AND t.account_id=ms.account_id JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_master i ON i.account_id=ms.account_id AND i.ingredient_id=r.ingredient_id WHERE ms.account_id=#{account_id} AND ms.status NOT IN ('CANCELED','COMPLETED') AND t.status<>'CANCELED' AND ms.meal_date<CURRENT_DATE AND ms.meal_date>=DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE,INTERVAL 14 DAY) AND ms.meal_date<#{date_from}

SELECT ,r.total_required_qty quantity,r.base_unit,ms.meal_date,m.menu_name FROM the_full_order.tb_account_meal_ingredient_requirement r JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_meal_service ms ON ms.meal_service_id=r.meal_service_id JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_table_meals t ON t.table_id=ms.table_id AND t.account_id=ms.account_id JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_master i ON i.account_id=ms.account_id AND i.ingredient_id=r.ingredient_id LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_menu_master m ON m.account_id=ms.account_id AND m.menu_id=r.menu_id WHERE ms.account_id=#{account_id} AND ms.status NOT IN ('CANCELED','COMPLETED') AND t.status<>'CANCELED' AND ms.meal_date BETWEEN #{date_from} AND #{date_to} AND ms.table_id=#{table_id}

SELECT , GREATEST(b.current_base_qty-COALESCE((SELECT SUM(l.remaining_base_qty) FROM the_full_order.tb_account_inventory_lot l WHERE l.account_id=b.account_id AND l.ingredient_id=b.ingredient_id AND l.location_id=b.location_id AND (l.status NOT IN ('AVAILABLE','CONSUMED') OR l.expiration_date<#{date_from})),0),0) quantity,b.base_unit FROM the_full_order.tb_account_inventory_balance b JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_master i ON i.account_id=b.account_id AND i.ingredient_id=b.ingredient_id WHERE b.account_id=#{account_id}
SELECT ,i.safe_stock_base_qty quantity,i.base_unit FROM the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_master i WHERE i.account_id=#{account_id} AND i.active_yn='Y' AND i.safe_stock_base_qty>0

SELECT ,r.quantity,r.base_unit,ms.meal_date FROM the_full_order.tb_account_meal_stock_usage r JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_meal_service ms ON ms.meal_service_id=r.meal_service_id JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_master i ON i.account_id=ms.account_id AND i.ingredient_id=r.ingredient_id WHERE ms.account_id=#{account_id} AND ms.status='COMPLETED' AND r.reversed_at IS NULL AND ms.meal_date>=DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE,INTERVAL #{average_days} DAY) AND ms.meal_date<=CURRENT_DATE

SELECT , GREATEST(oi.order_qty-COALESCE(oi.received_order_qty,0),0)*oi.base_qty_per_order_unit quantity,oi.base_unit, po.requested_delivery_date delivery_date,po.status order_status,oi.item_status, po.purchase_order_id FROM the_full_order.tb_account_purchase_order po JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_purchase_order_item oi ON oi.purchase_order_id=po.purchase_order_id JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_master i ON i.account_id=po.account_id AND i.ingredient_id=oi.source_ingredient_id WHERE po.account_id=#{account_id} AND po.requested_delivery_date<=#{date_to} AND po.status NOT IN ('CANCELED','FAILED','RECEIVED') AND oi.item_status NOT IN ('CANCELED','FAILED','RECEIVED')

SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(ar.ingredient_id,hr.ingredient_id) ingredient_id, COALESCE(i.ingredient_name_std,i.ingredient_name_raw,hi.ingredient_name_std,hi.ingredient_name_raw) ingredient_name, COALESCE(i.base_unit,hi.base_unit) master_unit,hm.menu_name FROM the_full_order.tb_favorite_menu f JOIN the_full_order.tb_menu_master hm ON hm.menu_id=f.menu_id AND hm.del_yn='N' LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_menu_master m ON m.account_id=#{account_id} AND m.menu_id=f.menu_id AND m.del_yn='N' LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_recipe_detail ar ON ar.account_id=m.account_id AND ar.menu_id=m.menu_id LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_master i ON i.account_id=ar.account_id AND i.ingredient_id=ar.ingredient_id LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_recipe_detail hr ON m.menu_id IS NULL AND hr.menu_id=hm.menu_id LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_ingredient_master hi ON hi.ingredient_id=hr.ingredient_id WHERE f.owner_type=#{favorite_owner_type} AND f.owner_id=#{favorite_owner_id}
